freeair.source: Free-air gravity anomaly, NASA GMM-3 to degree 100 (PDS GGMRO_120_ANOM_100, Genova et al. 2016), mGal – PDS MRO-M-RSS-5-SDP-V1, sampled at 1°

bouguer.source: Bouguer gravity anomaly, NASA GMM-3 to degree 90, crust 2900 kg/m3 (PDS GGMRO_120_BOUGUER_90, Genova et al. 2016), mGal – PDS MRO-M-RSS-5-SDP-V1, sampled at 1°

crust.source: Crustal thickness from GMM-3 gravity and MOLA topography (G. A. Neumann, NASA GSFC; PDS GGMRO_120_CRUST), km – PDS MRO-M-RSS-5-SDP-V1, sampled at 1°

grs_source: Mars Odyssey GRS element concentrations, smoothed 5°×5° (PDS ODY-M-GRS-5-ELEMENTS-V1, Boynton et al. 2007)
